source_edition: ISA DMS 6.0r12, 31 October 2023; ICD 6.0r5; Component Requirements 6.0r4

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Current Load, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: AC current consumed by a load.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Keep AC distinct from DC and consumption distinct from production.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Current Source, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: AC current produced by a source.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not stored charge, capacity, or consumption.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Voltage Load, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: AC voltage used by a load.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not source-side voltage or a supply rating inferred from a reading.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Voltage Source, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: AC voltage provided by a source.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Do not interchange source and load roles.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Active, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: True reports the device actively carrying out its responsibilities.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not merely enabled and not independent proof of successful physical effects.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Armed, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
primary_records.original_meaning: Boolean arming state; the source associates its presence with arming before active command invocation.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: An arming-state description is not an authorization, command, or performed action.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Attached Orientation, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Orientation in the attached parent's local frame, applied after Attached Position; Orientation takes precedence on conflict.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Source requires Relationship.parent link ATTACHED; not a network-membership inference.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Attached Position, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Translation in a physically attached parent's local frame, before Attached Orientation.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a world coordinate or an inferred installed mounting point.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Brightness, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic brightness is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Enabled adjustment is not its resulting brightness or a factory default.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Contrast, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic contrast is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Separate enabling flag from current contrast.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Focus, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic focus is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Separate enabling flag from current focus or successful focusing.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Gain, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic adjustment of signal gain is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a current gain magnitude or a measured outcome.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Level, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic adjustment of pixel values is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Does not supply a missing precise definition of the separate Level property.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Scan, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Whether automatic scanning is enabled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not scan area, cadence, completion, or performed observation.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Brightness, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: Current brightness expressed as Percent.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Percent is a source type; do not invent an absolute luminance unit.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Built In Test Result, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
primary_records.original_meaning: General State describing results of the last built-in test that ran.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Result is not the self-test command, test capability, or independent health certification.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Camera Mode, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Current camera mode; source defines switching and simultaneous-mode representation separately.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Camera-specific subtype of a general operating-mode row; do not turn mode-components into guaranteed physical devices.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Capability Version, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Configuration version for the particular component, compared by ISA to a software release number.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not automatically hardware, software, or standards version.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Charged, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Boolean reporting whether the component is charged.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: No percentage, threshold, charge chemistry, or actual capacity is defined here.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Contrast, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Camera contrast relative to its maximum.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not brightness, gain, or an observed environmental contrast measure.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Crypto Filled, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Boolean indicator described by ISA as crypto key filled.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not key material, algorithm choice, trust verification, or authorization proof.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Current Load, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: DC current consumed by a load.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Keep DC distinct from AC and consumption from production.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Current Source, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: DC current produced by a source.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not load current or an energy-capacity measurement.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Voltage Load, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: DC voltage used by a load.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not necessarily a supply rating or source output.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Voltage Source, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: DC voltage provided by a source.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not load voltage, battery state of charge, or stored energy.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Data Inputs, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
primary_records.original_meaning: Associative collection describing data being received; Data Transfer supplies endpoint and optional transfer state/rate/completion.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Transfer occurs outside the ISA connection; not a signal input definition or a transducer-channel inventory.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Data Outputs, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Associative collection describing data being sent, using Data Transfer.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Source distinguishes ongoing transmission from merely available resources; not a reported output-field schema.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Enabled, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: True indicates that the device is allowed to become active.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the Active flag, a successful operation, or general access-control proof.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Eye Safe Distance, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Source-reported minimum eye-safe distance, using Measured Meters.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A model field is not a verified safety limit for a specific installed device.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Field of Regard, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Total camera/component view over the scan time; uses the Field of View angular structure.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Different from instantaneous field of view and from a world-space footprint.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Field of View, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Instantaneous angular view; width is required and height can be absent when unknown.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A missing vertical angle is unknown, not zero; distinguish type from same-named property.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Focus, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Current focus expressed as Percent.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not focal distance or a physical lens setting inferred from the percentage.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Frame Rate, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Frame rate of camera-produced video, using Measured Hertz.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not device heartbeat, observation period, or command update rate.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Frequencies, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: List of frequencies in use by an emitting component, using Measured Hertz.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the full supported-band catalogue or evidence of a command being issued.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Ground Intercept, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Geographic position where the component's pointing vector meets the ground.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the sensor's own position, mounting point, or observed target identity.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Hardware Version, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
primary_records.original_meaning: Version of hardware used by the component.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension in this edition; not core by virtue of a table-of-contents bullet.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 IP Addresses, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Interface-name-to-current-address associations, with plus-suffixed subinterface naming for multiple addresses.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not UCI, device serial number, physical interface containment, or a mandated CSAPI URL.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Identity, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: MIL-STD-2525-based classification through Standard Identity, including symbol and optional confidence.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not manufacturer, model, serial number, or persistent component identifier.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Iris Size, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Iris size expressed relative to its maximum.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not an absolute aperture diameter or f-number.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Level, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Source declares a Percent single value; no property-description prose is supplied.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Related level commands describe a setting but do not uniquely establish its measured/controlled referent.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Link Loss, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Source declares a Db single value; no property-description prose is supplied.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Do not infer packet-loss rate, propagation attenuation, a reference power, or a sign convention.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Link State, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Associative Boolean status: true for interface up and false for interface down.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the physical ATTACHED/DETACHED Link type or general component availability.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Local Orientation, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Rotation from the component's standard position in its own frame, after Local Position.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not parent-relative Attached Orientation or world orientation; preserve transform order.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Local Position, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: Translation from standard position in the component's own frame, after attached transforms and before Local Orientation.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not an absolute geographic location or a substitute for the attachment relationship.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Maintenance, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: People or groups to contact for maintenance, as a list of POC structures.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension; not service history, a maintenance event, or a prescribed interval.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Manufacturer, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
primary_records.original_meaning: String naming the component's manufacturer, producer, or vendor.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Source permits a vendor/producer label; do not assert it always names the actual fabricator.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Manufacturer POC, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–29)
primary_records.original_meaning: Manufacturer contact list using the POC extension; source advises also supplying Manufacturer for compatibility.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension distinct from the core Manufacturer String property.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Model, printed p.14 (PDF pp.29–29)
primary_records.original_meaning: String identifying the component's model within its manufacturer's product line.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Same subject required; not a serial number, arbitrary nickname, or firmware version.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Serial Number, printed p.16 (PDF pp.31–31)
primary_records.original_meaning: Component serial identifier unique within its manufacturer's model line; the full manufacturer/model/serial tuple is expected to be unique.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Hardware interpretation requires a physical component; serial alone is not declared globally unique.

identifier_reconciliation.element_kind: identifier data type with component requirements
identifier_reconciliation.original_meaning: Persistent unique identifier of the particular ISA component, with specified character rules and a parent-derived virtual-component suffix.
identifier_reconciliation.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 UCI p.55/PDF70; ICD 6.0r5 §6.1 p.19/PDF27; Component Requirements 6.0r4 §4.1.1 [CMPT-H-0001], [CMPT-M-0001], [CMPT-L-0001]–[CMPT-L-0008] pp.7–9/PDF14–16
identifier_reconciliation.correction: Remove the earlier unsupported phrase network-scoped. The source says unique to the component; no network-only uniqueness scope is asserted.
identifier_reconciliation.mapping_boundary: ISA component identity can represent a virtual component; it is not automatically the persistent identifier of the whole physical arrangement or a URI. No issuing authority or instance authenticated here.
lexical_requirements: plus sign reserved for virtual-component IDs
virtual ID = supporting component UCI + plus sign + identifier unique among its virtual components
identifier_reconciliation.source_spelling_note: DMS and ICD expand UCI as Universal Component Identifier; Component Requirements uses Unique Component Identifier.
identifier_reconciliation.certificate_binding: ICD §6.1 connects UCI with the certificate Common Name; Component Requirements §4.1.2 specifies matching Common Name. These are requirements, not evidence authenticating our equipment examples.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Boolean; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Two possible truth values; used without inventing timing or authentication semantics.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Source atomic textual value. Identifier-specific grammar comes from UCI requirements, not a generic String assumption.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Percent; printed p.54; PDF pp.69–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Floating-point relative measure; the source permits values beyond 100. Do not impose a universal 0–100 restriction.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Source supports positive/negative dimensionless fractional values and infinities; no extra DIM numeric constraints adopted.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Integer; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Native integer definition inspected for address fields; its range is not silently made a new DIM requirement.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Wildcard; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Carries a type defined in the data model; does not mean untyped arbitrary meaning.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Amps; printed p.51; PDF pp.66–66
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Electrical-current unit; native simple type is Float with a nonnegative range.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Volts; printed p.55; PDF pp.70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Electrical-potential unit; native Float range includes both signs.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Hertz; printed p.53; PDF pp.68–68
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Frequency unit; native simple type has a nonnegative range.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters; printed p.53; PDF pp.68–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Linear-distance Float type; native range is not assumed from the property label.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Degrees; printed p.52; PDF pp.67–67
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Angular-distance Float type.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Mbpsec; printed p.53; PDF pp.68–68
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Transfer-rate unit represents millions of bits per second.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Db; printed p.52; PDF pp.67–67
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Logarithmic ratio type. It supplies a unit but not the missing reference for Link Loss.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Amps; printed p.96; PDF pp.111–112
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Amps; optional error:Amps. Error is expressed at plus/minus one standard deviation.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Volts; printed p.104; PDF pp.119–119
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Volts; optional error:Volts with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Hertz; printed p.99; PDF pp.114–115
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Hertz; optional error:Hertz with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Meters; printed p.101; PDF pp.116–117
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Meters; optional error:Meters with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Degrees; printed p.98; PDF pp.113–114
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Degrees; optional error:Degrees with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning; definition continues across pages.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Mbpsec; printed p.101; PDF pp.116–116
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Mbpsec; optional error:Mbpsec with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Rotation; printed p.111; PDF pp.126–127
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required pitch, roll, yaw as Measured Degrees; source applies yaw about z, then pitch about y', then roll about x''. Preserve the sequence.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Translation; printed p.113; PDF pp.128–129
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required x/y/z as Measured Meters; own/component frame is right-forward-down. Definition continues to PDF p.129; not Geographic Position.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 General State; printed p.93; PDF pp.108–109
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required General Code plus optional machine-readable subcode and human-readable details.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 General Code; printed p.79; PDF pp.94–94
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: FAILURE, FAULT, OK, UNINITIALIZED and WARNING retain their distinct operating-state meanings.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Camera Mode; printed p.77; PDF pp.92–92
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: LWIR, MWIR, OTHER, SWIR, VISIBLE BW and VISIBLE COLOR are the source enumeration values; distinguish the type from the property.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Data Transfer; printed p.92; PDF pp.107–107
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required URL endpoint; optional General State, Measured Mbpsec rate and Percent completion. Transfer is outside the ISA connection.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Field of View; printed p.93; PDF pp.108–108
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required angular width and optional angular height (Measured Degrees). Omitted height means unknown; not zero.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Position; printed p.95; PDF pp.110–110
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Latitude/longitude required; altitude and error-ellipsoid terms optional with source defaults. Preserve the source altitude/geoid text without substituting sensor position for ground intercept.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.2 IP Address; printed p.84; PDF pp.99–99
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Union of IPv4 Address and IPv6 Address.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 IPv4 Address; printed p.96; PDF pp.111–111
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Four required integer fields, one for each address byte.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 IPv6 Address; printed p.96; PDF pp.111–111
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Eight required integer fields, one for each 16-bit address group.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Standard Identity; printed p.113; PDF pp.128–128
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required SIDC symbol with source default and optional confidence; describes tactical/battlefield identity aspects, not unique asset identity.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 SIDC; printed p.55; PDF pp.70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Symbol identification string referenced by Standard Identity; source cites MIL-STD-2525C, not a serial or UCI.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 POC; printed p.106; PDF pp.121–121
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Accepted extension requiring organization and optional name, phone, email and details. Additional details use Resource Descriptor with text/vcard media identification; source requires custom-type construction.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Descriptor; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required resource type and URL, optional title/created/lastmod, and metadata name-value pairs. Inspected here for POC details and the transfer-versus-resource distinction.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Type; printed p.111; PDF pp.126–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required primary/secondary media labels and a list of parameter name-value pairs; used as text/vcard in POC details.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Name Value Pair; printed p.105; PDF pp.120–120
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required name:String and value:Wildcard; value meaning depends on the declared type.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Custom Type; printed p.92; PDF pp.107–107
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Wire representation is a list of name-value fields.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §7.3 Custom Type Declaration; printed p.71; PDF pp.86–86
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Named custom type with description and field declarations. Read to support the accepted POC extension; full capability mapping stays with ISA-08.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §7.3 Field Declaration; printed p.71; PDF pp.86–87
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Name, description, type, structure and optionality are distinct declarations; a type declaration is not a current property value.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Associative Array; printed p.85; PDF pp.100–100
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Values are typed name-value pairs according to a Property, Parameter or Observable Declaration; not a physical topology.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 UCI; printed p.55; PDF pp.70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Identifies a specific component persistently. DMS examples allow logistics assignment or a manufacturer/model/serial construction; it is not inherently limited to one network.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 URL; printed p.55; PDF pp.70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Source location/retrieval string; not a unique hardware identifier.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 UTC; printed p.114; PDF pp.129–129
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Secs is a fixed UTC timestamp with millisecond resolution; optional error:Secs. No nanoseconds field is declared here; no original resultTime is inferred.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Relationship; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–125
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Optional parent and zero-or-more child Relation Links; read to establish the actual ATTACHED condition of the position/orientation properties.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Relation Link; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–125
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required UCI and Link fields.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Link; printed p.80; PDF pp.95–95
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Sealed physical-attachment vocabulary ATTACHED and DETACHED; not the same as network-interface Link State.

questions.known: DMS property declares Percent / Single Value. Adjust Level and Change Level identify controllable relative level; Auto Level mentions pixel adjustment.
questions.question: The property entry itself does not define the precise referent of Level. Is it a generic component setting or specifically an image-processing level in the intended use?
questions.decision: Keep the native term and declared type visible; do not map it to battery level, brightness, absolute intensity or a unique physical quantity.
questions.evidence: DMS §3.1 p.13/PDF28; Adjust Level p.26/PDF41; Change Level p.32/PDF47; Auto Level p.10/PDF25.
questions.next_resolution: ISA-05/06 review the full related command context; ISA-11 reconcile companion guidance. If the wording remains sparse, preserve this exact source question without blocking other completed mappings.

questions.known: DMS property declares Db / Single Value, without explanatory prose. Db defines a logarithmic ratio, not its reference.
questions.question: Which link quantity/reference and sign convention does this property use?
questions.decision: Retain native Link Loss and Db. Do not equate it with packet loss percentage, physical detachment or a particular attenuation ratio.
questions.next_resolution: ISA-09/11 check relevant communications guidance and linked state descriptions; only original source evidence can specify the missing referent.
